SYSTEM INSTRUCTION — SECTOR POST-SESSION REVIEW

Same spirit as general post-market autopsy, but the object is ONE sector ETF and its
environment — not SPX.

INPUTS (injected):
1. Morning sector prediction for this sector
2. Channel 1: actual sector ETF open/close/% change; SPY % change; relative return
3. Archived morning ETF context

STEPS (do not skip):
0. FACTS: sector ETF %, SPY %, relative %, path if known
1. What drove the sector today (taxonomy-aligned factors preferred)
2. Audit morning S0–S4 reads against reality (use morning numbers, not post-close
   rewrites of the morning)
3. Interactions / double-count / knowable-at-open test
4. Outliers inside the sector

Evidence: CLAIM/URL/PUBLISHED/QUOTE/SUMMARY format for factual claims.

Scope: mag=0.1 → mild/flat only; last three XLC losses prefer flat/mild when leftover tape is asked to set direction. Open experiment: milder band when |score|<4.

# Communication Services (XLC) — 2026-09-03

Object is the **near-session XLC environment**, not SPX and not a stock pick. XLC remains a two-name duration/growth book (META ~17%, Alphabet A+C ~18.4%, NFLX/DIS mid-single digits). Telecom weight is limited; AMX/APP/TTWO must not drive the ETF.

## Channel 1 (used as given)

VIX **15.18** (−0.02d), VIX/VIX3M **0.999**. DGS10 **4.79** (+0.04d / +0.15w), DGS30 **5.27**, **DFII10 2.44 (1d 0.00 / +0.12w)** — real yields **not a same-morning crush**; the 1w backup is already in the curve. Finviz 10Y note **+0.17%**, 30Y bond **+0.38%**. DXY **−0.35%**. **ES=F +0.13%, NQ=F +0.16%** (flat, inside ±0.5%). Asia composite **+0.04%**, Europe **+0.19%**. CL=F **−0.26%** / BZ=F **−0.28%**; Finviz WTI **−1.19%**, Brent **−1.07%**. Gold **+1.48%**. HY OAS **2.65** (tight). 10Y–SPX 5d corr **−0.795**. F&G **58.2 Greed** is stale 08-27.

XLC vs SPY through **2026-09-02**: **1d rel +0.95%** (XLC +1.39% / SPY +0.44%), 3d **+1.68%**, 1w **−0.57%**, 1m **−0.02%**.

## Channel 2

**1. Shared macro → this sector.** Risk-on helps XLC **only if mega-cap growth participates**. This morning it does **not clearly**: NQ **+0.16%** vs ES **+0.13%** is noise, not a mega-cap growth impulse. News Judge’s AVGO beat/raise is **XLK/SOX**, not an XLC holding — 08-27 forbids mapping that into S0=+. Premarket META/GOOGL are mixed-to-softly green in some quotes, NFLX mixed/flat — not dual-leader failure and not a confirmed rip.

Warsh/hike-odds (~60–70% for a September hike) and the divided Fed hold are **already in the curve** (News Judge #1). Do **not** re-score them as a fresh S0 HIT. Count **one** rates object, and it is **stale**.

Hormuz/US-Iran remains in the tape at still-high **~$90 / ~$95**, but Channel 1 oil is **down** (WTI −1.19%, Brent −1.07%). That is **not** the 08-11/08-12 supply-shock family (oil up + NQ ≤ −0.5%). 08-13 reversal checklist: oil falling **yes**; futures green **no** (not ≥+0.3%); XLC 1d rel improving **yes but already paid**. Geo is a residual overhang, not a same-morning down mandate.

**Calendar (verified):** this is **not** “no print.” **8:30 ET jobless claims** (cons ~205k), trade balance, productivity revisions; **ISM Services 10:00 ET** (cons ~54.2 vs 54.1). **NFP is Fri 09-04**, not today. ADP printed 09-02. Soft labor/services are **two-sided** for this book (duration relief vs growth scare). Futures did **not** independently confirm either branch. Do not pre-score Friday.

Net S0: **0**. 08-21 forbids S0=−1 on leftover Warsh/PCE; 08-27 forbids S0=+1 from non-XLC AI beta; 08-11 geo cap is off because oil is falling.

**2. Spine (mandatory).** Digital-ad recovery and AI monetization **proof** remain **one** carried thesis (eMarketer 2026 Meta ads ~$243.5B vs Google ~$239.5B; Meta Q2 ads ~$59.4B +27% / Advantage+; Alphabet Search/YouTube/Cloud +82%). Not a same-morning revenue print — do not pay S1+. Goolsbee’s “dangerous side of AI spending” is an XLK/capex crowding comment, not XLC ad-monetization proof. No fresh Meta/GOOGL ad-recession print. Forrester-style open-web display cuts are **reallocation toward social/CTV**, not a Meta/Google demand collapse — do **not** HIT ad-budget-cut.

Regulatory: Meta **settled** the 29-state teen case **08-26** — **stale-resolved**. **09-02 Google ad-tech remedies: behavioral changes, no breakup** — that is the knowable offset that already printed into yesterday’s XLC +1.39% / GOOGL green. Classify as **stale-positive**, not a fresh S1+. Alphabet search/ad-tech remains structural. Capex vs FCF (Alphabet Q2 FCF −$5.9B; Meta FCF crushed) is the standing caveat, not a new number. Net spine **0**.

**3. Secondary.** Engagement/MAU with monetization: checked, nothing material. Antitrust **relief**: the no-breakup ruling is already traded; New Mexico Meta trial ~Sep 8 is not today. Telecom ARPU/subscriber: **AMX upgrade is not an XLC driver**. Engagement deceleration: AppLovin PT cut is ad-tech adjacent, not META/GOOGL. Telecom price war: checked, nothing material. MAP HEAT: entertainment/broadcast/gaming residuals are **down** (TTWO/GTA leak, NFLX mixed) but must not dominate a META+GOOGL book. Rotation: yesterday’s +0.95% 1d rel is **already on the tape** — S4 description only, not an S1 HIT.

**4. Breadth / leadership.** 08-28: leftover 1w −0.57% is history, not live breadth. Premarket dual-leaders are **not still failing**. Large-cap leadership inside the sector is context, not % names expanding. Do **not** re-score 09-02’s mega-name bounce as independent S2 (08-14). Single-ticker APP/AMX/TTWO/AVGO **must not** drive the ETF call. **S2 = 0**.

**5. Flows / positioning.** ETFdb: XLC **5d ~+$61M**, 1m **−$20M**, 3m **−$1.76B**. Inverse of 08-11: a one-week trickle is **not** same-day support; 3m outflows are **not** a 1-day lid (08-28). Crowding is mega-cap + unresolved capex, not an extreme 1d relative spike (1w still lagging). **S3 = 0**.

**6. Earnings / policy.** No fresh META/GOOGL/NFLX print. Load-bearing same-day prints are **claims 8:30 / ISM Services 10:00**, not a comms report. AVGO is XLK. NFP is Friday.

## Lessons / audit

- **08-28:** S0=S1=0. Do not copy 1w lag or 3m units into a down call. Default **flat/mild**, not down.
- **08-27:** AVGO/Goolsbee/NQ +0.16% is **not** XLC S0=+. Do not emit up from foreign AI beta.
- **08-14:** 1d rel **+0.95% < +1%** and is **yesterday’s** bounce. Score once; do not stack S2/S4 into up/notable. Follow-through after an outsized relative day is usually **mild/flat** without a new comparable top-holding catalyst.
- **08-13 / 08-11:** Oil falling → geo down-cap **off**. Do not re-apply 09-01’s Hormuz down/mild stack.
- **08-21:** Futures not ≥+0.3% → reversal checklist **fails**; that is a ban on S0=−1, not a license for S0=+.
- **08-17/08-18:** No fresh both-leader legal shock; severe is off. Google no-breakup is an offset that already traded.
- Leading sum (S0+S1+S2+S3) = **0** vs S4 **0** → **no divergence**. Factors and tape agree on **no-up / no-down**.
- Rolling mag **0.1** and |Σ|<4 → multiplier **0.9**, band **flat**. Do not let pipeline rewrite this to notable.

Near-session XLC setup is a **pause after a one-day catch-up**: structural ad/AI intact but not fresh, rates/hike-odds already priced, oil sliding so geo is not the 08-11 lid, and leftover 09-02 relative strength is not a second-day notable bid.
